title: Daily Focus brief
description: The payload the briefing agent writes to items.json. See AGENTS.md for the rules that a schema can't express — above all, that ids must be stable across runs.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the run that produced this file.

generatedBy.description: Free-form label naming whichever agent produced this brief. The dashboard shows it, and does not care which agent it is.

date.description: The local date this brief is for.

headline.description: One or two sentences at the top of the page. Inline Markdown: **bold**, `code`, [text](url).

dayStart.description: Local time today's working day starts, derived from the calendar. Overrides the dashboard default.

dayEnd.description: Local time today's working day ends. Set this when the day is short — free windows and remaining focus time are computed from it.

id.description: Stable across runs — actions are keyed on this. Derive it from upstream identity, never from the title or the date. e.g. "github:pr:acme/webapp#3421".

source.description: Aliases such as gmail, gh, google-tasks and confluence are normalised by the dashboard.

kind.description: task = completable; event = goes on the agenda; info = context only.

detail.description: A sentence or two of context. Inline Markdown supported.

url.description: Deep link. Non-http(s) URLs are dropped.

priority.description: Lifts the item into the Top priorities band. Use for at most three items.

start.description: Events only. A bare YYYY-MM-DD means all-day.

blocking.description: Events only. False when the event belongs on the agenda but must not consume time — a delivery window, a booking, anything you are not sat inside. Absent means blocking; only an explicit false frees the slot.

firstSeen.description: ISO date this item was FIRST raised. Carry it forward across runs so the dashboard can age it.

advancesObjective.description: True only when completing this genuinely moves the objective in focus.md forward. Drives the "days since objective progress" metric, so a generous reading makes that number lie.
